name: calendar-app
description: A private Google Calendar app built with Effect, Foldkit, and Alchemy.

scripts.check: pnpm run lockfile:check && varlock load && turbo run typecheck lint:root
scripts.deploy:plan: pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=1 && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployPlan
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=1 && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployProd
scripts.deploy:rollback: pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=1 && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployRollback
scripts.prepare: effect-tsgo patch && if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi
